headline: Satin Creditcare Network Limited: Allotment of 2,500 Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Satin Creditcare allotted 2,500 non-convertible debentures (NCDs) with face value ₹1 lakh each, aggregating ₹25 crore, in a debt capital raise completed on 30 March 2026.
implication: NCD issuance by a microfinance-focused NBFC signals capital adequacy management under RBI's NBFC regulations; the debenture structure and allotment timing are material disclosure events for listed debt investors.
detail: Satin Creditcare Network Limited, a listed non-banking financial company (NBFC), completed allotment of 2,500 Non-Convertible Debentures each with a face value of ₹1,00,000 and aggregate nominal value of ₹25,00,00,000 (₹25 crore). The allotment intimation was filed with NSE on 30 March 2026. This debt issuance is a standard capital-raising mechanism for NBFCs to meet statutory reserve requirements and liquidity coverage ratios. The specific terms (coupon, tenor, security/unsecured status, whether listed or unlisted) are not disclosed in the allotment notice itself.

framework.ref: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) – Master Direction on Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)
framework.note: central; governs NBFC capital raising, issuance of debt securities, and statutory reserve requirements for all NBFCs, including microfinance entities.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) – Master Direction on Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities, 2021
framework.note: central; defines NCD issuance, listing, investor protections, and disclosure norms for all public issuers of debt.
central; sets the statutory framework for issuance, redemption, and security of debentures by Indian companies.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Rules / BSE Listing Rules – Chapter VII (Debt Securities)
framework.note: central; mandates allotment intimation and public disclosure to the exchange within stipulated timelines.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 – Section 194LA (Tax on Interest on Debentures)
framework.note: amended; TDS rate on debenture interest is 10% (or lower if PAN provided); material for investor net-yield analysis.
